extraction.Name: Mary Prue Blacksmith
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband supports you and they.
extraction.NOTES: Four people depend on her for support; received $5500 — traded land with her father and then sold the land she got from him for $4500 in cash; not satisfied with sale, states had she sold when she first got the patent she would have received more; patent delivered March 15, 1920 at the postoffice at Okreek; signed a receipt for the patent; in good health; document notarized May 7, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
